# MailCatcher NG

> MailCatcher NG is a Ruby gem (`mailcatcher-ng`) for development. It runs a simple SMTP server that catches every email sent to it and shows the messages in a web interface, so nothing is delivered to real recipients.

Default ports: SMTP on smtp://127.0.0.1:1025, web UI and REST API on http://127.0.0.1:1080.

Install and run:

- `gem install mailcatcher-ng`
- `mailcatcher`
- Point the application's SMTP settings at 127.0.0.1:1025, then open http://127.0.0.1:1080/
